span.p: 读读不互斥 → 读多写少性能提升

span.p: state 高低位：高16位读 / 低16位写

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
写锁降级：持写锁 → 取读锁 → 释放写锁
（先释放再取 = 留竞争窗口，错）

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
StampedLock 乐观读：不锁读 + validate
失败才升级悲观读
→ 写频繁场景反而更慢

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: ReentrantLock 实例（03-02）

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
公平 vs 非公平：
非公平 = lock() 先抢 + tryAcquire 再抢
= 两次插队机会

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
为什么非公平快：利用唤醒间隙
（代价：极端可能饿死排队线程）

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
可重入：owner + state 计数
重入无需 CAS（只有持有者能进）

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
四种获取：lock / lockInterruptibly
tryLock / tryLock(timeout) → 防死锁

span.p: 共享模式 + Condition

span.p: acquireShared：tryAcquireShared < 0 失败才排队

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
setHeadAndPropagate：
获锁后继续唤醒下一个
（一次释放多个许可，防许可浪费）

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Condition：await = 入条件队列
→ 释放锁 → park → 抢锁返回

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
signal：条件队头搬到同步队列
多 Condition = 精确唤醒（对比 notifyAll）

display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: acquire：tryAcquire 失败 → addWaiter 入队

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: acquireQueued：前驱是 head 才 try，否则 park

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
park 前把前驱设 SIGNAL
→ 前驱释放时唤醒我（防丢唤醒）

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
head 是哑节点：持锁者不在队列
head.next = 等待最久的人

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: release：tryRelease → unparkSuccessor 唤醒后继

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
synchronized 局限：
不可中断 / 不可超时 / 唤醒无差别

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
AQS：锁的统一骨架
state(volatile，含义子类定) + CLH 队列 + Node
模板方法：子类只实现 tryAcquire/tryRelease
